subject: POC MAP & network tie-in — API keys, org setup, IP allowlist, VPC peering
messages:
From: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@carelytics.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: netops@carelytics.com
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC MAP & network tie-in — initial ask

Hi Aditya,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team liked the latency profile and the model routing examples. As we discussed, we want to lock down the mutual action plan items that are gating our POC close so we can pick a target run window the week of July 5. The things we need to confirm from Redwood to close our internal evaluation checklist are: 

- Org creation & RBAC for our evaluation tenant (we want a dedicated org for the POC).
- API keys for both streaming and non-streaming endpoints (test keys that expire after 30 days).
- IP allowlist and recommended ephemeral key guidance for initial testing.
- VPC peering requirements and a preferred peering window (we run maintenance Sundays 02:00–05:00 PT).

I attached our draft MAP (CareLytics_MAP_v1.pdf) with suggested dates and owners. NetOps is on copy for CIDR confirmation — they can also take the peering tech call.

Can you send a short runbook with owners and a proposed timeline so I can surface to procurement and engineering? We’d like a single one-page checklist for our leadership sign-off.

Thanks,
Maria

--
Maria Gomez
Director, AI Integrations | CareLytics
maris.gomez@carelytics.com
Attachments: CareLytics_MAP_v1.pdf (application/pdf, 348KB)
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@carelytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC MAP & network tie-in — initial ask

Maria — thanks for the clear list and the MAP draft. Attaching a short internal runbook and a VPC peering requirements text file (redwood-vpc-peering-reqs.txt). Below is a concise plan we can put on a one-pager for your execs; if this looks good we’ll update the MAP PDF with committed dates.

Quick MAP runbook (proposed):
- Org + RBAC: Redwood creates evaluation org “carelytics-eval-2027” (Owner: Aditya). ETA: 2 business days after PO/LOE sign-off.
- API keys: Issue scoped test keys (stream + standard) with 30-day TTL. Delivery: secure notes in HubSpot + console. Owner: Marissa Cole. ETA: same-day once org exists.
- IP allowlist: We need your CIDR(s). We will provide recommended egress ranges for our hosted endpoints and a sample iptables ACL for your firewall. Owner: Neha Kapoor (network). ETA: 1 business day after CIDR receipt.
- VPC peering: Prep doc attached. Typical lead-time 3–5 business days from ticket creation; preferred peering windows are weekdays 01:00–05:00 PT or Sunday 02:00–05:00 PT (you noted Sunday maintenance — we can schedule outside your maintenance if needed). Owner: Neha.
- Validation & smoke tests: Redwood will run smoke traffic and a short latency/correctness testbed; we’ll provide a checklist for your SREs. Owner: Marissa.

Proposed timeline to meet your July 5 run window:
- Jun 16: Confirm CIDRs + sign MAP PDF (CareLytics).
- Jun 17–18: Redwood creates org + issues test keys.
- Jun 18–21: Network teams coordinate peering (tech call) and apply allowlist.
- Jun 22–24: Smoke tests, canary routing, sign-off.

Action items for CareLytics today:
1) Confirm CIDR ranges and preferred peering day/time.
2) Confirm point of contact for peering ticket (name + email).
3) Approve the one-page runbook or send edits.

If you prefer, Marissa can run the HubSpot playbook and deliver the keys via secure notes. Shall I lock the Jun 17 org-creation slot?

Thanks — I’ll wait for CIDRs and POC contact.

Best,
Aditya

--
Aditya Rao
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com
Attachments: redwood-vpc-peering-reqs.txt (text/plain, 4KB)
From: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@carelytics.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: netops@carelytics.com
Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2027 08:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC MAP & network tie-in — initial ask

Aditya — thanks. NetOps provided the CIDRs below and prefer a weekday peering during your suggested window (Mon–Thu 01:00–03:00 PT). Our network contact is:

- Julio Alvarez (netops@carelytics.com)
- CIDR blocks: 10.12.0.0/20, 10.45.128.0/22

Two quick clarifications:
1) For the first week of the evaluation we’d rather use ephemeral keys rather than long-lived test keys — is there a recommended flow to rotate ephemeral tokens against your hosted endpoints?
2) Are there any IPs we need to allow on our side for Redwood’s control plane (we prefer one outbound egress range to minimize firewall rules)?

I attached the signed one-page MAP marked with the proposed dates (CareLytics_MAP_v1.pdf). If you can confirm ephemeral-key flow and the control-plane egress ranges we’ll schedule the tech call with Julio tomorrow.

—Maria

Attachments: CareLytics_MAP_v1.pdf (application/pdf, 352KB)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@carelytics.com>, Julio Alvarez <netops@carelytics.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC MAP & network tie-in — initial ask

Maria / Julio — looping in Neha to pick up the peering coordination. Short answers and confirmed next steps below so you can close procurement scheduling: 

1) Ephemeral keys: we support short-lived bearer tokens via our Console + Token API. Recommended pattern for eval: Redwood issues a 24-hour token via a signed initial test key; your test harness will request refresh tokens from our Token API (we’ll provide example curl and SDK snippets). Owner: Marissa. Deliverable: sample rotation script (will be uploaded to the Drive link).

2) Control-plane egress ranges: please allow outbound to the following CIDRs for control-plane calls and webhook callbacks: 34.122.16.0/22, 34.122.20.0/22. We’ll limit domains to api.redwood-inference.com and auth.redwood-inference.com in the runbook. Owner: Neha.

3) Tech call: proposed slot — Monday Jun 21, 01:30–02:30 PT for VPC peering handshake and firewall ACL validation. Julio / netops please confirm and we’ll calendar invite.

4) Deliverables we’ll upload by EOD Jun 18: updated MAP PDF with committed dates, ephemeral token rotation example, and peering ticket template. Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-carelytics-map-v1

If those CIDRs and the Monday slot work we’ll create the org on Jun 17 as planned and issue the initial scoped test key once the org is live.

Thanks — happy to be brief on the call.

Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0123
Attachments: (see Drive)
